cards.title: 未改动查询 patch 的参考条件响应
cards.gap: Cross-image static final features can rank a distractor ahead of the target. A frozen encoder may nevertheless respond differently at the unchanged target pixels when a reference-class stimulus is present elsewhere; current static comparisons never measure this conditional response.
cards.history_evidence: RESULTS joint encoding best cut lower by2.77/1.97 than matched l24; ProM1 shared-KV suffix first4 ctx25.113 vsuniform35.135; ProM4 paired22.142, ref_canvas31.260 with17encodings; object-removal revision0 allIoU0/newTP0. These do not positively support this candidate. ProM4 reads pasted known-object points and estimates environment covariance; here the readout is exclusively unmodified main-image patches and the FG-versus-BG intervention difference, not the pasted probe or absolute joint encoding.
cards.available_information: Same legal R/Q RGB, complete MR, existing frozen CPU DINO. Known foreground bbox+fixed16pixel natural context full rectangle; matched negative replaces MR-inside pixels by nearest known R-background pixels, MR-outside identical. Pixel replacement is not a guarantee of semantic object absence.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: Changing only a distant FG/BG probe can expose conditional attention sensitivity absent from the original final representation. This is only a possible observable: duplicate-instance echo, global colour shifts or positional effects can dominate it, and source response separation does not prove semantic transfer to Q.
algorithm: Make canonical R/Q main windows1024x768 in upper48 patch rows; reserve bottom16 rows for a probe panel. Main pixels are identical between conditions; sample only upper48 rows.

From completeMR create bbox+16px natural-context RGB rectangular probe; negative replaces onlyMR pixels by nearest knownR-background RGB, outsideMR unchanged. No FG alpha silhouette. Missing knownclass gives common control.
At two fixed panel locations separately encode foreground probe and background probe for each of R/Q:8 forwards total, no other image sources.
Average raw final-LN difference D=H_F-H_B over two locations at unchanged main patches; pasted-panel rows never enter R/Q response or head.
Area-resample complete MR into main R48x64; compute weighted response means muFG/muBG from known R labels.
For every unchanged Q patch margin=(||Dq-muBG||²-||Dq-muFG||²)/(sum distances+1e-12); if response means coincide, use same-view mean-feature prototype control.
Resize full main margin48x64 to Episode q-grid, fixed common render; not a selected ROI or old FoRIS residual.

expected_benefit.action: change identity sorting using a class-conditional response at unchanged pixels

cards.simplest_control: Same8 views: main feature average prototype; foreground-only main feature prototype; background-only main feature prototype; source probe feature matching readout (ProM4-style absolute inserted evidence) on unchanged Q. Same main-window geometry and decoder. Native raw prototype is an additional resource-separated baseline.
cards.why_not_duplicate: Different measured location/decision from old cropCLS/objectremoval/pasted-object environment classifier: remote intervention, unchanged Q token, conditional difference, complete direct field. All probe sizes/colours/locations are one family and not separate methods.
cards.counterexample: Identical reference object in R induces strong duplicate-instance echo, but different-instance same-class Q does not respond. Global ambient delta identical everywhere gives no identity signal. Near-class distractor may respond more strongly. Probe panel can cause attention competition rather than attraction.
cards.first_evidence: Toy frozen attention encoder from legal pixel-derived keys with instance-noise and class-pattern trait: require a different-instance target conditional response, compare same-view averages and inserted-point controls. Exact local-content identity/panel exclusion verified. Linear ambient-shift-only and instance-hash echo negative must fail. Then root runs the single fixed full method on real4, sealed beforeQGT.

Bound12minutes for one4-episode batch incl matchedcontrols/cache, max16view cache, <=6GiB/worker target, actual peak/runtime to record. No automatic600 expansion.

cards.failure_learning: Separate source response discrimination from Q edits; if source strong/QnoTP, conditional instance matching did not transfer. If mean-view control is equal/better, response head unnecessary. If delta nearly constant, no usable identity observable, not an optimizer error.

cards.title: 保留局部像素的外部上下文敏感度
cards.gap: A token's apparent target identity may be driven by surrounding scene composition rather than its unchanged local pixels. Existing grey/crop experiments alter the local input too and cannot separate outside-context sensitivity from content destruction.
cards.history_evidence: ProM1 shared attention context and ProM5 real QK message changes were fixed negatives; gray first4 weaker than RGB/H20. This does not establish that spatial context permutations have a transferable class sensitivity. Old objectremoval changes the selected pixels and global CLS/pooled descriptors; this intervention leaves the scored region byte-identical and reads its own patch changes.
cards.available_information: Legal whole R/Q originalRGB and full MR, frozen CPU DINO; no query labels/seeds. Each original patch belongs to exactly one of4 fixed physical quadrants.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: For each quadrant leave its RGB and position intact while cycling the other three quadrants. At its tokens, ||H_original-H_perturbed|| measures dependence on outside arrangement while local pixels do not change. Whether FG/BG sensitivity measured on R predicts Q is unknown; sensitivity is not inherently background.
algorithm: Canonical RGB1024 grids; for each k=0..3 keep quadrant k pixel-identical and cycle remaining3 quadrants, no rotations or resizing inside quadrants.
Encode4 perturbedR and4 perturbedQ views; score each patch only from the view that preserved its quadrant. All original tokens appear once.
Use existing native raw-unit R/Q as origin; callback final-LN features are unit-normalized before sensitivity norm, consistent native comparison.
sR/sQ=norm(original-unit feature minus preserved-quadrant edited-unit feature), inverse geometry matches exact corresponding native patch.
Compute known-R class weighted sensitivity means aF/aB; signed scalar nearest-mean margin=(sQ-aB)²-(sQ-aF)², normalize positive distance sum.
Coincident source class means or no known class returns same8-view preserved-patch mean-feature prototype; full qgrid and common render.

expected_benefit.action: reject context-driven apparent targets or recover stable local targets when source sensitivity distinction transfers

cards.simplest_control: Same8 views: average original and preserved-patch edited features then known-R prototype; full vector-change prototype; scalar original token norm (constant for unit features). Same geometry/window. No different crop or extra forward-budget advantage.
cards.why_not_duplicate: New physical outside-context observable; differs from cached feature pooling, local RGB erasure, whole-image grayscale and attention suffix reweighting. Other permutations/quadrant numbers are variants of this one method, not counted.
cards.counterexample: A true object is context-dependent while generic grass is stable; background sensitivity from R flips in Q. Query object spans a quadrant boundary and outside permutation destroys its continuation. Source means may differ merely because boundary proportions differ.
cards.first_evidence: Byte-for-byte preserved quadrant audit and complete coverage; toy nonlocal encoder with same local pixels but class-correlated context influence, paired context-dependent-true-target negative. If scalar sensitivity versus vector/mean controls adds nothing, record that. Real4 once byroot, no source-fit success treated as Q gain.
cards.cpu_cost: 8 new1024 forwards/pair, same148s/group4 extrapolation from root37s two-forward measurement, actual cost unknown. <=16 cached views, target6GiB/worker; one bounded4-episode probe <=12min, no further search.
cards.limitations: Uses source labelled scalar calibration, not learned base classes; R/Q sensitivity calibration may not transfer. Window boundary continuation is a declared failure mode, not hidden crop difference. Existing features must be same checkpoint/1024 canonical geometry.
cards.failure_learning: If local pixels fixed but features change, observable exists; that alone is not benefit. If true targets are more context-sensitive than RFG expected, transfer assumption fails. Compare source/conditional statistics and fourQ edit classes after sealed evaluation.

cards.title: 双参考刺激的非加性交互响应
cards.gap: A first-order response can cancel between feature directions or equal a global ambient shift, even if semantic attention saturates differently when two class cues are present. Need a measurable nonadditive interaction rather than another intensity/colour setting.
cards.history_evidence: ProM4 environment covariance and ProM5 midlayer messages negative; firstcard remote response is unmeasured. Higher response order alone is not proof of new effective method, and this card must be rejected as a variant if no distinct nonadditive witness survives same-view controls. No claim that old models establish saturation.
cards.available_information: Same R/Q RGB, reference FG/BG probe pair from completeMR, actual frozenCPU encoder, no labels beyondMR. Two fixed bottom-panel slots, unchanged main1024x768 window.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: Encode assignments(F,F),(F,B),(B,F),(B,B). The raw-LN mixed difference C=H_FF-H_FB-H_BF+H_BB is identicallyzero for any additive probe effect. It can carry class-dependent nonlinear interaction even when H_FF-H_BB is identical on classes. It is not monotonic rescaling of firstdifference, but could still be duplicate-instance interference rather than category signal.
algorithm: Same exact probes/main-window/panel geometry as firstcard; both slots filled at identicalshape/area, only knownFG/BG content differs.
Encode4 assignments forR andQ, total8 freshforwards; retain only unmodified upper48x64 patches.
Compute raw final-LN C=H_FF-H_FB-H_BF+H_BB, before any new unit normalization, avoiding normalization-created curvature.
Learn knownR response means muF/muB with fullMR area weights; everyQ patch compares squared distances to these means as in firstcard.

If source response means coincide or below nominal arithmetic guard max(1e-6,8*eps_float32*sum(mean raw view norm)), use same-view avg prototype. Guard is subtraction-only nominal, not a forward-error certificate. Full margin/common renderer.
Controls same8views: firstdifference H_FF-H_BB response head; avgH head; two single-slot finite differences; allcontrols share raw-LN handling.

expected_benefit.action: change identity through measurable stimulus interaction when first-order and absolute-feature responses do not separate

cards.simplest_control: All above same-view8 controls; additive toy encoder must giveCzero and exactfallback. Nonadditive toy with equal firstdifferences must distinguish different-instance target before acceptance of uniqueobservable. Panel token exclusion/seam geometry fixed. Same-view four-state raw-stack squared-distance prototype control must also be evaluated, not just firstdifferences.
cards.why_not_duplicate: Only if nonadditive witness exists beyond firstorder/full average. One two-stimulus interaction decision, not multiple finite-difference orders or intensities. DifferentC/firstdifference quantities do not guarantee semantic usefulness; reviewer decides counting.
cards.counterexample: Two reference copies compete for attention and suppress identical-instance features while realQ objects have different effect; panel seam effects themselves nonadditive. Signal may be tiny float32 cancellation or universallyzero. Nonzero curvature is not category discrimination.
cards.first_evidence: Frozen pixel-driven polynomial/attention toy where a class has responsea*n+b*n² witha adjusted so firstdifference cancels but mixed second difference differs; noQGT in encoder. Additive and instance-only echo negative. Verify CcomputedfromrawLN notunitLN and compare every sameviewcontrol. Then rootreal4 once; if no measuredCclasssignal, close fixed version rather than try moreorders.
cards.cpu_cost: 8 new1024forward/pair;148s/group4 extrapolated, <=16viewcache and6GiB/worker target. Potentialcache overlap with firstcard acknowledged, not counted as quality. One4batch <=12min; noautomaticextraorders/600.
cards.limitations: A toy proves an observable can be nonadditive, not that frozenDINO has useful curvature. Source class separation may be exact-reference echo; same-class transfer is the real unverified assumption. Negative result narrows this interaction construct, not all semantic DINO information.
cards.failure_learning: Report Cnorm versus raw/firstdifference norms and floating precision; if nearroundoff it is numerics, if stablebutBG/FGnondiscriminative it is missingidentitysignal, if sourceonly it is transfer/echo. Don't equate nonlinear response to causal semantic evidence.

cards.title: 局部像素不变的位置轨道重编码
cards.gap: DINO final patches may include geometry/context contributions that differ with reference/query object positions. A corresponding object part's local RGB is identical under a patch-aligned image roll, but its encoder position and nonlocal neighbourhood across the seam change; re-encoding exposes this dependence.
cards.history_evidence: FoRIS conditional position removal was in oldprocessed cache; not unprocessedDINO. Existing fine-readout ±4px shifts improve interpolation about+.35 and middle-layer magic failed. This method uses512px patch-aligned roll with inverse token permutation, unchanged16x16 patch bytes, no resolution/crop increase and nointerpolationgain claim. Globalmean/CORAL negative does not support it.
cards.available_information: Same original R/Q RGB canonical1024 and fullMR, originalnativeunitfeatures, actualfrozenCPU encoder. Completeoriginal reference mask is applied after inversefeature mapping, noQGT.
cards.new_observation_or_argument: Inverse-mapped re-encoded features can separate content from position-dependent terms if their semantic component survives a coarse roll and nuisance changes sign/averagesout. This is a newforwardobservable, not shifting oldarrays (which would unroll exactly and add0information). Wholeobjects crossing the seam may be damaged, and RoPE relative invariance could leave nochange.
algorithm: CanonicalR/Q RGB1024; produce horizontal512px roll and vertical512px roll. Whole16x16 native patches are moved unchanged; encode4 views total (2perimage).
Inverse-roll64x64 feature maps by32token columns/rows, recovering everyoriginalpatch location; no scored pixelmask has moved.
Average originalnativeunitfeatures with inverse-mappedunit re-encoded features; unit final mean; compute completeknownR FG/BG prototypes withoriginalMRweights.
Score everyoriginalQ token by averagedfeature FG-minus-BG cosine; commonnativegridandrenderer; allinstances eligible.
Controls sameviews: inverse-map then average scalarper-viewprototype margins; eachrollalone; no-new-encoder roll/unroll ofcachedfeatures must be algebraically identicalbase.
